name: @picteus/mcp-server
description: Exposes a MCP server over the Picteus API.

scripts.clean: npm run clean:generated && npm run clean:dist
scripts.mcp:generate: npm run clean:generated && openapi-mcp-generator --input ../../../back-end/openapi.json --output ./generated --server-name "picteus-mcp-server" --transport streamable-http --custom-auth --force --generate-lib && shx cp ./src/auth.ts ./generated/src/auth.ts
scripts.compile: npm run clean:dist && tsc && shx cp -r ./generated/public ./dist/generated/public
scripts.build: npm run mcp:generate && npm run compile
